selection.primary: Maximum equal-fold mean MAP@5; eligible candidates ranked by mean DESC then config_id ASC.
selection.eligibility: NEW candidate mean > V2 mean AND mean > V3 mean, strictly positive V2 delta in >=2 folds, min fold V2 delta >= -.002.
selection.phase_b_trigger: If Phase A has ZERO eligible new candidates, perform one supervised reranker phase with <=4 predefined configurations; do not stop at a negative Phase A. Phase B code/features/origins/params must be separately frozen before its scores.
selection.phase_b_skip: If Phase A has an eligible candidate, select the highest-mean eligible candidate and skip Phase B.
selection.no_early_diagnostic: Only after all required phases and final rolling selection, evaluate V2, V3 and ONE selected new candidate on stress and old_window; no retuning or new models after these diagnostics.
selection.no_eligible_after_b: If both phases lack eligible candidates, pick highest-mean new candidate for error/diagnostic reporting only and create no best CSV.
selection.diagnostic_recommendation: Recommend separate submission only if rolling eligible AND both diagnostic deltas vs V2 >= -.002 AND both deltas vs V3 >= -.002. Refitting rolling-eligible candidate is allowed; diagnostic risk must remain explicit.
selection.same_users: 1260 exact-string template users, all users included, empty truth AP0, repeats allowed, no truth injection.

formulas.base: HL28, power.5, tau30, V2 direct implementation; V3 direct frozen cf_idf_l015.
formulas.partial_source: Union matched fragments per user-airing, clip separately to [2020-03-09,cutoff), coverage=watched/full airing duration. Qualified coverage>=.8 unchanged; weak ONLY .05<=coverage<.8 AND watched>=60s.
formulas.partial_weight: weak_ui=sum_e coverage_e**p * 2**(-(cutoff-last_time_e)/(28*86400)), p2/4; L1 normalize per user, NO extra square root.
formulas.partial_score: a_ui=sqrt(r_ui)/sum sqrt(r); h_ui=weak_ui/sumweak; profile=(1-mix)*a+mix*h; s=(n*profile+30*g)/(n+30), n=V2 original available qualified mass. If weak absent, unchanged V2. n0 exact original popularity fallback.
formulas.opportunity: An airing can qualify in [L,R) iff overlap>=.8 full-duration. Raw mode counts distinct channel,start,end,item; slots mode collapses identical item,start,end across channels. Labels never collapsed.
formulas.exposure: D=.5*(E_last28+E_long*28/train_days); R=(F*28/target_days+1)/(D+1); score=V2score*clip(R,.25,4)**beta. future timetable allowed, future viewing forbidden.
formulas.combo: partial_score multiplied by same exposure correction; fixed partial mix.25.
formulas.probability: Only complete training airings end<=cutoff and .8 train eligibility. Weight both exposure D_i and qualified numerator Y_ui by 2**(-(cutoff-airing_end)/(28*86400)); mu_i=sum_uY_ui/(Utrain*D_i); p_ui=(Y_ui+kappa*mu_i)/(D_i+kappa); c_ui=p_ui*Fraw_i. Utrain=all distinct qualified train users before candidate filtering. L1 normalize c, blend with V2 distribution; unsupported uses V2. Validate finite 0<=p<=1 and Y<=D.
formulas.ranking: score DESC numeric item ID ASC; same candidate pools and five unique nonzero IDs; zero qualified own available mass uses unchanged fallback in all Phase A variants.

schedule_policy.max_schedule_scope: Only rows overlapping [train_start,target_end); full end of a crossing airing retained for denominator, no future period aggregate beyond target_end.
schedule_policy.duplicate_conflict: Same prepare labelled schedule cleaning; training air_ids stable; future exact channel/start/end/item duplicates collapsed, conflicting labelled airings excluded from exposure while original availability pool unchanged.
schedule_policy.final: Original31-42 schedule plus qualified carryover from training schedule; no reconstructed future logs.
